newsitem.title: UK: London gold slips to fix at fresh low since 1993.
newsitem.headline: London gold slips to fix at fresh low since 1993.

text.p: Gold prices slipped to $366.55 per ounce, the lowest figure seen since November 1993 after touching a four-week low of $367.80 at the morning setting.
Dealers said light selling in New York edged bullion lower in quiet trading conditions. Its last fixing of 1996 on Tuesday was $369.55. On November 3, 1993 it fixed at $363.00.
"We saw some fund selling on Comex just before the fixing. Before that there really wasn't any direction in the market after the holidays," one dealer said.
The February Comex futures contract ended down $2.00 at $369.20 on Tuesday, with most of the selling coming in the closing minutes of the session.
Some dealers questioned whether the move represented a serious retrenchment for the gold price. "It may be a bear trap," one dealer said.
Even so, the outlook for gold was still largely bearish. "A gold clear-out would be good for gold. I can see it down to $330-$340 in the early part of this year," a dealer said.
